newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end lower on consolidation.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end lower on consolidation.

text.p: 1420 GMT - Austrian shares end off amid slim volumes. Traders say market under pressure from profit taking and expect further consolidation at present levels.
* ATX index down 6.51 points or 0.52 percent at 1,249.92.
* Five ATX shares higher, 15 lower, one unchanged
* Top decliner OMV, down 1.77 percent at 1,390 schillings.
* Leading gainer brickmaker Wienerberger, up 1.32 percent at 2,300 schillings
* March ATX future down 5.0 points at 1,252.5.
* Vienna bourse index down 1.34 points or 0.29 percent at 464.96 -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12257
